verdict.rationale: Claude is itself the AI assistant. First-party material says users can hand off and schedule tasks, have Claude search the web, create files and run code, and work on long-running tasks in shared workspaces. Community reports corroborate real delegation, such as finishing a work project and one-shot fixing a UI bug. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the delegation workflow (the cited docs are marketing taglines), and evidence on how reliably delegated long-running or scheduled tasks complete.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Search the web, create files, and run code
Collaborate with Claude on shared workspaces and long-running tasks.
Use Claude in your terminal to write, review, and ship code.
